text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — metering: token-count drift detected in eu1. Multiple overage flags firing. Alert id: metering/eu1/73821. Investigating.

maria: On-call here, looking now. Which signals are tripping?

kev: Seeing a 3x emission spike from emitter-4 around 03:12 UTC. Kafka lag looks normal on consumers. Could be duplicate replay.

raj: I can run a reconcile query. @maria @kev can you paste the dashboards?

maria: https://dash.redwood/eu1/metering -> spike starts ~2024-10-12T03:12Z, overage flags start ~03:17Z. :warning:

billing-eng: We're already seeing queued overage emails for a small set of customers. Can we throttle or suppress while we investigate? Need customer impact status.

kev: Early hypothesis: emitter retry loop during upstream 503s created duplicate batches. Checking emitter logs now.

kev: log snippet:
```
emitter-4 | 2024-10-12T03:12:15Z ERROR send failed status=503 retry=1 token_batch_id=abc123
emitter-4 | 2024-10-12T03:12:16Z INFO send succeeded token_batch_id=abc123
```

raj: Running reconcile query to surface dupes:
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) as tokens
FROM raw_token_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2024-10-12T03:00:00Z' AND '2024-10-12T03:30:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
(should highlight duplicated batches for some customers)

maria: Plan: run dedupe preview + suppress overage flags temporarily. Command (preview):
`/opt/tools/metering dedupe --start 2024-10-12T03:00 --end 2024-10-12T03:30 --mode=preview`

oncall: Please run preview first. Do NOT suppress customer emails until preview confirms duplication.

kev: Preview output shows ~1.9M duplicated tokens attributed to emitter-4 across 6 customers (most impact concentrated in two enterprise accounts).

billing-eng: If that's accurate, we'll retract the automated overage emails and queue a corrective customer update. Need estimated ETA for mitigation.

maria: ETA ~20-30m: rolling restart emitter, run dedupe (non-preview), then validate. Starting now.

kev: Deploying hotfix to emitter-4 to add short idempotency guard while we root-cause. Command: 
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/emitter-4 -n metering
```

incident-bot: Note: scheduled on-call rotation in 10m. @oncall please confirm you remain pinned for this incident.

oncall: I'm staying, coordinated w/ maria. I'll monitor the billing queue and confirm suppression once dedupe finishes.

raj: Post-incident action: add dedupe TTL enforcement and an alert that triggers on short 5xx spikes combined with burst emission. Filing Jira after this thread.

billing-eng: Thanks. Holding off customer comms until validation. Will prepare a draft for review. :thumbsup: 

maria: Restart complete, dedupe running (progress 30%). Posting counts when finished.

kev: Dedupe finished. Processed tokens back to baseline; dashboards show overflags cleared. :white_check_mark:

billing-eng: Retracting queued emails and scheduling a customer follow-up about false overages. Will include root cause and mitigation.

incident-bot: Incident moved to resolved status pending postmortem. Please create Jira ticket and link to this thread. :lock:
